notes.title: Prepare the helm, pilot, it's time to take off! 🛬
notes.content:
It's now about time to help Arthur navigate through his first stressful day at the new airport - an experienced pilot is about to meet people and circumstances that he wasn't ready for - so you've got to help him navigate through all of this! [b]SEX Airlines[/b]🔞✈️ is our first game, and we really hope you guys will enjoy it! We tried to deliver plot, graphics and other aspects as well-designed as we could - we're a small team who just begins their development journey. That being said - please, let us know what you think about the game and characters, let us know aspects we could improve and do better, let us know if there are any technical issues - feel free to share anything that's on your mind.

As a little surprise for our first players ever - we've got free keys, grab one and try it out!

notes.title: Get ready for Patricia Airport! 🛫
notes.content:
Arthur is an experienced pilot coming straight from San Francisco to start a new chapter of his life working at Patricia Airport - until things turned out unexpectedly. In the waiting area, he meets Jenny, a lovely passenger who's later going to get the whole flight canceled due to serious issues with documents.
Take your turns on this whole situation - meet your new colleagues and find common ground with them, try to help and comfort Jenny while she's detained and needs a place to stay and a shoulder to lean on. 

[b]Find the best way around all these for yourself this Saturday already![/b]

Make sure to wishlist the game and come for the release on time - or your plane might take off without you 😉

[h2]Coming this Saturday – don't miss out![/h2]📢

notes.title: Your flight takes off soon! Or does it?.. 🛫
notes.content:
Our first ever game is in active development - we can't wait to tell you about it! Imagine this situation: since something weird happened to your documents - you're stranded in an airport. Rough, isn't it? But it's not that bad - you're not the only one. Meet Jenny, who found herself in the same boat as you did, and should I mention that she's blazingly hot? Not only her, supportive pilot Maya and strict local police officer - watch out for her!

[h3]We're super excited about this project, and we'd love it if you'd joined the journey - make sure to wishlist the game![/h3]

Let us know what your expectations are and if you have any suggestions! Stay tuned and get ready to dive into an adventure.

Catch you later! ✋
